accepted.quote: It is not the place of Congress--which is not accountable to D.C. residents--to micromanage the District and act as some kind of super legislature, second-guessing their laws.
accepted.rationale: The quote asserts Congress should not override District laws, indicating strong support for D.C. self-governance.

accepted.quote: The D.C. police reform legislation aimed at accountability for police officers who use excessive force or abuse their power. It increased transparency and provided stronger civilian oversight.
accepted.rationale: The quote praises police accountability, transparency, and civilian oversight measures as positive reforms.
